description: Mike directive 2026-05-17: verify the social-hub agent-gate + state-flip chain. (1) on boot, presence sits in BOOTSTRAP and is NOT pinging out -- the connect code on the wire would otherwise be device-scoped rather than agent-scoped. (2) on --launch-load-agent, socialRebindToActiveAgent re-derives the handle + connect code from (pubkey || agent_name), and presenceMarkAgentLoaded flips state to ONLINE_IDLE so outbound pings can start. (3) when the client then transitions into a gameplay stage (--launch-mission 0x30), mainChangeToStage flips presence state to IN_MATCH so friends see accurate status while the player is in-match.

input_sequence.comment: boot + agent-load + mission transition is fully scripted via CLI fast-paths; no menu input needed.
scripted exit after presence states have flipped through bootstrap -> online -> in-match.

required_lines: PRESENCE: initialised state=bootstrap scheduled=\d+ \(awaiting agent load\)
PRESENCE: agent loaded -- state=(online|in-match), social hub activity enabled
